description: List the items of an open object library (id, name, type, description; optionally filtered), close a library (Library panel menu > Close Library), and set the Library panel's view (thumbnails, large thumbnails, list) and sort order (Sort Items). To open or create a library use transfer_resource_file

filter.description: list: only items matching all given criteria (case-insensitive)

library.description: Name of an open library, as the Library panel tab shows it (e.g. "Parts.indl"); default: the first open library

sort.description: sort: Sort Items by name, newest, oldest or type

view.description: view: Thumbnail View, Large Thumbnail View or List View

name: manage_object_library
title: Manage Object Library
